title: MonaCode differential fixture
description: A single differential case for the MonaCode differential harness (P00-T008). M0 (npm monaco-editor@0.56.0), M1 (built comparator), and the native MonaCode subject run against ONE identical injected environment trace. Raw UTF-16 inputs and outputs are persisted as arrays of 16-bit code units (0-65535) so that unpaired surrogates survive WITHOUT Unicode repair. Every fixture distinguishes the exact and native-adapted comparison domains.

id.description: Stable fixture identifier. Must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ and be unique within a fixtures directory.

input.description: Raw UTF-16 input as a sequence of 16-bit code units. Persisted without Unicode repair, so unpaired surrogates (e.g. 55296 for 0xD800) are representable.

expected.description: The expected outputs per comparison domain. `exact` is byte-for-byte equality with the M0/M1 oracle. `nativeAdapted` is the documented native divergence permitted for the MonaCode subject.

environmentTrace.description: The single identical injected environment trace shared by M0, M1, and the native subject. Carries every injected domain established in P00-T005/T006/T007: wall and high-resolution clocks, the shared random sequence, the crypto bytes, the runtime locale/calendar/numbering/time zone, and the explicit UI message profile.

highResolutionMilliseconds.description: Monotonic high-resolution milliseconds (P00-T005 high-resolution domain). Separate from, and never substituted for, wall-clock.

randomDoubles.description: The shared deterministic random sequence (P00-T006). Each value is a binary64 Double in [0, 1).

localeIdentifier.description: Runtime locale identifier captured at startup (P00-T007).

calendarIdentifier.description: Runtime calendar identifier captured at startup (P00-T007).

numberingSystem.description: Runtime numbering-system identifier captured at startup (P00-T007).

timeZoneIdentifier.description: Runtime time-zone identifier captured at startup (P00-T007).

profileIdentifier.description: The explicit UI message-profile identifier (P00-T007). Selected only from the explicit environment option; never derived from the locale.
